page.overview:
Who is Medell?

Medell was a king of Temeria and the son of Queen Bienvenu La Louve and king consort Hugo of Rivia. He married Sancia of Sodden and the couple had two children: Foltest and Adda of Temeria, thus also making him the grandfather of Adda the White.

Sometime around the s, Medell's army marched on Aedirn, and were defeated at Hagge by King Virfuril and his forces.
